cases.description: A brief names a worktree, the no-git rule and the team fields in ten lines or fewer.
cases.prompt: You are the lead. Write a herdr-team brief to dev-opencode for a small task in `C:\repo`. The worker must use its own worktree at `../repo-c3`, may only edit `src/a.py`, and must not commit or push. Use the team brief format. Return only the brief.

must: no git|no commit|do not commit|no push|do not push

cases.description: A worker report uses STATUS, CHANGED, TESTS and NOTES.
cases.prompt: You are the worker. You finished the task: changed `src/a.py`; `pytest` passes. Write the report to the lead using the team report format. Return only the report.

cases.description: A blocked target is waiting for the user; never send keys, tell the lead.
cases.prompt: A target agent is blocked waiting for the user. What do you do? One sentence.

must: tell the lead|report (it )?to the lead|notify the lead|escalate
never send|do not send|don.t send|leave .{0,20}alone|wait for the user|blocked|do not interact|don.t interact|stop and wait

cases.description: An assignee does not re-delegate a brief; it reports back.
cases.prompt: You are an assignee and you received a [team from dev-claude] brief. May you delegate it to another teammate? One sentence.
